{{Top}}
{{Otheruses|Mother}}
[[File:MotherTalzin-SWE.png|thumb|right|200px|Mother Talzin, of the Nightsisters]]
{{Quote|Mother Rell is nearly three hundred years old, but her spirit is so strong that it will not let her body die.|[[Augwynne Djo]]|<ref name="copl">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref>}}
'''Mother''' was a title given to [[Gender/Legends|female]] elders or womanly leaders in various matriarchal cultures such as the [[Witches of Dathomir]] or the [[Tarasin]] [[Species/Legends|species]].

==Dathomiri Mother==
{{Quote|Mother Augwynne told me that you petitioned to join the Singing Mountain clan. We would like to welcome you back fully as a sister some day.|[[Teneniel Djo]] to [[Barukka]]|<ref name="copl" />}}
The "Mother" (sometimes [[Clan mother/Legends|clan mother]], "Matron"<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> or "Matriarch"<ref name="SWBES">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]''</ref>) honorific was also applied to leaders of [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomiri]] [[Witch/Legends|witches]] clans, including certain [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] covens.<ref name="copl" /><ref name="TBoS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> Such leaders included [[Gethzerion]], the founder of the Nightsisters, [[Talzin/Legends|Mother Talzin]], a Nightsister Shaman during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="TCWNS">{{TCW|Nightsisters (episode)}}</ref> and [[Rell (Dathomir)|Mother Rell]], oldest member of the [[Singing Mountain Clan]].<ref name="copl" />

The earliest Clan Mother of Dathomir was the banished [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Allya/Legends|Allya]], who literally sired the first witches and taught her daughters the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] through the lens of [[Dathomir Magic|magicks]]. A Dathomiri Clan Mother was the heir of Allya's authority over the clan members, known as [[Sister (Witches of Dathomir)|Sisters]].<ref name="copl" />

For a mere Sister, a convenient way for the echelons of power was to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the current Mother (similar to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] typical method of succession). If the assassination attempt was successful, the murderer was considered worthy of taking her victim's place. Around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], the young [[Ros Lai]] stabbed [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Zalem/Legends|Zalem]] with a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], to which other witches reacted by saying: "The Mother is dead. Long live the Mother."<ref name="SWIE">''[[Star Wars: Infinity's End]]''</ref>

==Tarasin Mother==
{{Quote|You become the Mother of the Hiironi because it is what the irstat wants. What you want is not important. What is best for you is not in your hands to decide. You are part of something much greater. We are Tarasin.|Dariana's mother to Dariana as a child|<ref name="Mother Memoirs">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20030102scenario|text=A Mother's Memoirs}}</ref>}}
On [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], a "Mother" was the eldest [[Gender/Legends|woman]] of a [[Tarasin]] [[irstat]]. This woman was considered a leader and wise-woman, usually having served for several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] as an [[Irstat-Kes]].<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In the context of the Witches of Dathomir, this title first appeared in [[April]] [[1994]] in [[Dave Wolverton]]'s ''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''.
